For your stir-fry, a good alternative to soy sauce that provides a similar savory, umami flavor for someone with a soy allergy is coconut aminos. It has a slightly sweeter and less salty profile than soy sauce but works well in stir-fries. Another option is tamari if the allergy is strictly to soy protein and not gluten, but since soy is the concern, coconut aminos is the safest and most direct substitute. You can also use a mixture of beef or mushroom broth with a splash of vinegar and a pinch of salt to mimic the depth of flavor.
